result.brief: 系统研究 MAE 与 DINOv3 的渐进深度增长预训练，分析其对下游性能、中间层表征与内部注意力计算模式的影响，并降低训练 FLOPs。
result.reason: Systematically studies progressive depth growth in MAE and DINOv3 self-supervised vision transformers, analyzing representation quality and internal computation—directly a visual representation learning contribution.
